display_name: Awareness E14: Social media and oversharing (defend only)
description: An awareness episode of about 8 minutes for all staff, on the defending side only. Sort a feed and an inbox at Merrin & Sallow Architects, a fictional practice: some posts give too much away, and some messages were built to pull work details out of you. Each answer is explained, and reporting when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down.
